Scenario: Register a new user account successfully
Preconditions: Application is installed; backend and Supabase services are available; test email is not yet registered
Procedure: 1. Open the mobile app; 2. Navigate to Register; 3. Enter valid email and password; 4. Submit registration form; 5. Verify through verification email; 6.Return to Application;7. Home Page is visible
Expected_Result: A new account is created successfully and the user is able to proceed to login using the registered credentials

Scenario: Login with a valid account and load dashboard data
Preconditions: Registered user account exists; backend API is reachable; mobile device has network connectivity
Procedure: 1. Open the mobile app; 2. Enter valid login credentials; 3. Tap Login; 4. Wait for session initialization; 5. Observe home screen
Expected_Result: User session is created, protected API calls succeed, and the dashboard loads authenticated user information without error

Scenario: Initialize a learning subtopic and load lesson content
Preconditions: User is logged in; at least one topic and subtopic exist in the database
Procedure: 1. Open Learn module; 2. Select a topic; 3. Select an available subtopic; 4. Initialize progress; 5. Load lesson details and content
Expected_Result: The lesson is displayed successfully and the user progress state is initialized for the selected subtopic

Preconditions: User is logged in; selected subtopic requires profiling; profiling questions are available
Test_Data: Subtopic ID: 1; Sample answers matching issued profiling quiz
Procedure: 1. Start profiling quiz from the selected subtopic; 2. Answer all profiling questions; 3. Submit quiz
Expected_Result: Profiling results are stored and the system returns an assigned starting difficulty for the learner

Workflow: Learning module -> quiz -> XP update -> leaderboard update
Scenario: Submit adaptive quiz attempt and receive result summary
Preconditions: User is logged in; progress is initialized; quiz questions exist for assigned difficulty
Test_Data: Subtopic ID: 1; Difficulty: basic/core/mastery; Valid answer set for all issued questions
Procedure: 1. Start quiz for the assigned difficulty; 2. Answer all questions; 3. Submit answers; 4. View quiz result
Expected_Result: Quiz attempt is recorded, correctness is evaluated, and the user receives pass/fail feedback with explanation or summary stage access

Workflow: Learning module -> quiz -> XP update -> leaderboard update
Scenario: Verify XP update after successful quiz submission
Preconditions: User has completed a quiz attempt; XP and leaderboard modules are enabled
Test_Data: User ID linked to recent quiz attempt

Expected_Result: The awarded XP is reflected in the user game summary and leaderboard rankings update consistently with the latest quiz result

Preconditions: User is logged in; virtual market bootstrap is available; stock and price data exist

Procedure: 1. OpenVirtual Stock Marke; 2. Trigger bootstrap if first time; 3. View available stocks; 4. Open portfolio screen

Workflow: Stock selection -> trade execution -> portfolio update
Scenario: Execute a buy order and update wallet and portfolio
Preconditions: User is logged in; wallet has sufficient balance; selected stock is unlocked; latest price exists
Procedure: 1. Select a stock from the virtual market list; 2. Enter a valid buy quantity; 3. Submit buy order;
Expected_Result: A buy order is created successfully, wallet balance decreases, order history is updated, and the purchased stock appears in the portfolio

Workflow: Stock selection -> trade execution -> portfolio update
Scenario: Execute a sell order and update wallet and portfolio
Preconditions: User is logged in; user already owns sufficient stock quantity in portfolio
Procedure: 1. Open Virtual Stock Market; 2. Select an owned stock; 3. Enter a valid sell quantity; 4. Submit sell order; 5. Add entry in Trade Journal
Expected_Result: A sell order is recorded successfully, wallet balance increases accordingly, and portfolio quantity is reduced after execution
